summaries.1: Title II short title: Open, Public, Electronic, and Necessary Government Data Act (OPEN Government Data Act).
summaries.2: New and amended 44 U.S.C. § 3502 definitions, including data, data asset, machine-readable, metadata, open Government data asset, open license, and public data asset.
summaries.3: OMB Director duties to issue open-data standards and guidance, and agency CIO/information-resources duties to collect and publish data as open Government data assets by default (44 U.S.C. §§ 3504, 3506).
summaries.4: Agency comprehensive data inventories and GSA’s Federal data catalogue (data.gov) under 44 U.S.C. § 3511, agency Chief Data Officers and the CDO Council, plus reporting.
summaries.5: P.L. 115-435 Title IV: rule of construction, use of existing resources, and delayed effective date (generally 180 days after enactment of 14 January 2019).
